# EDI: Experimental Design and Inference — llms-full.txt

This file is GENERATED at site-build time. If you are reading this text,
you have the source-tree stub, not the built artifact.

The real llms-full.txt is written by .github/scripts/build_llms_full.sh
after pkgdown builds the site (see .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml): it
concatenates the short llms.txt summary with the ENTIRE built documentation
— every article and every reference page (all design classes, inference
classes, C++ kernels and utilities) — as plain text, so an agent can ingest
the whole package in one fetch.

Fetch the generated file from the published site:

  https://kapelner.github.io/EDI/llms-full.txt

For the short summary and index instead:

  https://kapelner.github.io/EDI/llms.txt
